pedal: Boss DD-8 Digital Delay — stereo, fed through INPUT B alone (OUTPUT A and OUTPUT B)
comment: Does the DD-8 run two independent delays, one per input? The stereo session fed INPUT A (the mono input); here the same signals go into INPUT B with INPUT A empty. If OUTPUT A stays silent (or carries only crosstalk) and OUTPUT B has the dry and its repeats, the two sides are independent paths; if the repeats also come out of A, the sides are mixed or cross-fed, and how says which stereo output type the pedal is in. Standard only, Level, Feedback and Time at 12:00: clicks (each repeat's time and level per side), noise bursts (its tone), the stabs. Run right after the stereo session, nothing else moved.
